# LaunchScope

> A local macOS background-item inspection and management app with an auditable AI protocol.

## Agent entry points

- Protocol and safety boundary: docs/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md
- Purpose Rule Pack v1 schema: docs/schema/purpose-rules-v1.schema.json
- Repository skill: .agents/skills/launchscope/SKILL.md
- Local MCP server: mcp/launchscope_mcp.py
- MCP setup: docs/AI_INTEGRATION.md

Recognition rules explain an item. They do not authorize rule installation or launchd management.
